items.source: Backward-compatible factory alias for creating RedisStreamCommands.XTrimOptions from RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions.
items.translation: 用于从RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions创建RedisStreamCommands.XTrimOptions的向后兼容工厂别名。

items.source: Connection package providing low-level abstractions for interacting with the various Redis 'drivers'/libraries.
items.translation: 提供低级抽象的连接器包，用于与各种 Redis“驱动程序”/库进行交互。

items.source: Set the deletion policy for trimming.
Limit the maximum number of entries considered when trimming.
items.translation: 限制修剪时考虑的条目最大数量。

items.source: Create trim options using the MAXLEN strategy with the given threshold.
items.translation: 使用给定阈值和 MAXLEN 策略创建修剪选项。

items.source: Create trim options using the MINID strategy with the given minimum id.
items.translation: 使用给定的最小 ID 创建基于 MINID 策略的修剪选项。
